profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit investor founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California. Its site describes it as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence. The material published there mixes that investment thesis with commentary on AI-driven science, energy policy, autonomous driving, and tax policy, including a proposal to eliminate preferential capital gains treatment after 2028 and tax such gains as ordinary income, which the site says could generate approximately $400B per year.

Portfolio mentions on the site include Radical Health, which emerged from stealth with $5 million in pre-seed funding led by Khosla Ventures and uses AI to personalize cancer treatment guidance, described as an AI Oncologist intended to give every patient access to the care of a top cancer doctor. Another company is described as building a finance workflow platform on proprietary data and AI talent. Khosla Ventures is not itself attributed any products or MCP servers.

The company's litigation exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No individual lawsuits are listed.
